# TokenPAPA — Unified AI API Documentation Center

> TokenPAPA is a unified AI API aggregator that provides overseas developers with fast access to Chinese LLM APIs (DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, GLM-4, Moonshot) without phone verification, plus multi-model routing for GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5 and more.

## 核心导航链接

- [GitHub](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api)
